spec.name: Job Compensation Detector
spec.intent: Warn me when a job post is really commission-only or unpaid, even if it hides it.
spec.description: Identifies job postings that are unpaid, equity-only, or commission-only, distinguishing them from standard paid roles.

tests.input: Account Executive position offering a competitive $60,000 base salary plus uncapped commission on all software sales.
tests.why: The job includes a guaranteed base salary alongside commission.

tests.input: Earn up to $100,000 in your first year! High-ticket sales closer position. 100% commission payout per transaction.
tests.why: The compensation is strictly 100% commission with no base pay.

tests.input: Responsibilities include managing daily office operations, scheduling client meetings, and responding to customer support emails.
tests.why: This is a text fragment listing duties without mentioning compensation, so it gets the calm label.

tests.input: Great opportunity for aspiring writers! Create content for our online publication. Unpaid role, but excellent exposure for your portfolio.
tests.why: The position offers exposure instead of monetary compensation.

tests.input: Founded in 2018, Acme Corp is a leading provider of sustainable logistics solutions across North America.
tests.why: This company description fragment contains no compensation details.

tests.input: Seeking co-founder software engineer. 0% cash salary, 5% equity vesting over 4 years. Huge upside potential!
tests.why: The position pays zero cash salary and offers equity only.

tests.input: Summer research assistant needed. $200 total stipend for 30 hours per week across 10 weeks, intended for course credit.
tests.why: A nominal stipend for heavy hours alongside academic credit is considered an unpaid or stipend-only role.

tests.input: No hourly rate provided. You earn strictly based on the sales volume your team generates each month.
tests.why: Pay is entirely dependent on performance and sales volume with no hourly rate.

tests.input: Warehouse Associate - $18/hr. Shift times: 8 AM - 4 PM Monday through Friday. Paid weekly.
tests.why: The post provides a standard hourly wage.

tests.input: Tired of companies asking you to work for 'exposure'? We don't do that here. We pay a competitive $35/hr base rate.
tests.why: Mentions 'exposure' in a sarcastic/contrast context, but actually pays a standard hourly base rate.

tests.input: This is a strictly commission-based role where your effort directly determines your paycheck every week.
tests.why: Explicitly states the role is strictly commission-based.

tests.input: Looking for volunteer social media managers to help run our non-profit accounts 5 hours a week.
tests.why: The post asks for volunteer work without monetary compensation.

program.systemPrompt:
Analyze job post text fragments to detect unpaid or commission-only compensation structures.

Check for these signals:
1. 'unpaid job': Role is unpaid, volunteer, stipend-only, equity-only, or compensated only with college credit or exposure.
2. 'commission only': Role pay is strictly commission-based, 100% commission, OTE only with no base pay, or paid per sale with no guaranteed hourly or salary base.
3. 'standard pay': Role provides a base salary, hourly wage, base pay plus commission, or does not mention compensation at all.

Rules:
- Text fragments without compensation information (e.g., job duties, company description) must be classified as 'standard pay'.
- Guaranteed base pay combined with commission is 'standard pay'.
- If text indicates unpaid work and commission, prioritize 'unpaid job'.

examples.input: We are looking for an energetic Sales Executive! This role offers unlimited earning potential with 100% commission per closed deal. No base salary is provided.
examples.label: commission only
examples.reason: The posting explicitly states it is 100% commission with no base salary.
examples.evidence: 100% commission per closed deal. No base salary

examples.input: Join our fast-growing startup as a Marketing Intern! You will gain valuable experience and portfolio pieces. This position is unpaid but offers college credit.
examples.label: unpaid job
examples.reason: The posting specifies the role is unpaid and offers college credit instead of a wage.
examples.evidence: This position is unpaid but offers college credit

examples.input: Senior Software Engineer - $140,000 - $160,000 base salary plus annual performance bonus and full health benefits.
examples.label: standard pay
examples.reason: The posting includes a clear guaranteed base salary.

holdoutResults.reason: The text does not contain any information about compensation.
The role is compensated only with a stipend and course credit.
The role is strictly commission-based, with paycheck dependent on weekly effort.
